author: Kushal
problem: names lists choir members' full names, like 'Mary Ann Lee'. Return the names sorted by surname (the last word of the name), keeping the original order for equal surnames.
bug_description: Sorts by split()[1], the second word, instead of split()[-1], so members with three-part names are sorted by their middle name.

comments.accurate: Sorts members by the last word of their name, keeping ties in order
comments.wrong_behavior: Sorts members by surname, taken as the word after their first name
comments.wrong_location: Surname key verified; sorted() may not keep equal surnames in their original order
comments.wrong_output: Example: choir_by_surname(['Mary Ann Lee', 'Tom Hart']) returns ['Mary Ann Lee', 'Tom Hart']
